announcements.headline: HIGH COURT DECLINES SCHEME OF ARRANGEMENT
announcements.insight: Permanent TSB Group Holdings PLC's scheme of arrangement failed after the High Court declined sanction in November. This halts the acquisition process initiated in October.

announcements.headline: High Court Judgement
announcements.insight: Permanent TSB Group Holdings PLC has received ECB approval for its acquisition by BAWAG. This High Court Judgement finalizes the sanction hearing from October, completing the regulatory and legal steps required for the deal.
